newsitem.title: CHINA: Typhoon Victor slams into Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Typhoon Victor slams into Hong Kong.

text.p: Typhoon Victor hit Hong Kong on Saturday evening and weather forecasters said it was weakening into a severe tropical storm as it moved north across the territory.

The Hong Kong Observatory said the tropical cyclone was centred above Hong Kong at 2000 local time (1200 GMT) and it would not issue the feared super typhoon "10" signal because the storm was getting weaker.
However, strong winds and heavy rains would continue to batter the territory of 6.4 million people, the forecasters said.
Currently, a number nine signal, forecasting winds with speeds above 118 km an hour (73 mph), is hoisted. Nearby Portuguese-ruled Macau has also hoisted the same warning signal.
Air, land and sea traffic in both Hong Kong and Macau has ground to a halt.
